null heterogeneity must not create positive BLP RATE Qini or personalization support above the registered family error

surrogate paradox with favorable short-term and harmful long-term effect

effective sample size weight concentration and tail diagnostics bind claim scope

choose policy threshold on evaluation outcomes

replace long-term outcome with a correlated proxy
inherit source grade in the target
